results.headline: Whistlejacket Lithium Project Update
results.key_quote: These are highly encouraging visual indications from our maiden drilling programme at Whistlejacket. To have logged broad, visually identifiable spodumene pegmatite in all three of our first holes – and in particular the scale of the intercepts at WSTL0020 and WSTL0022 – gives us real confidence in the size and continuity of this system
results.summary: Bradda Head reported drilling results from the first three holes at Whistlejacket that intersected broad zones of visible fresh spodumene mineralization, with intercepts ranging from 19-46m. The company describes these as 'highly encouraging' and states the results give 'real confidence' in the project's size and continuity, building on Kennecott's earlier drilling. The results are described as exceeding confidence expectations for the maiden drilling programme. However, the company explicitly notes that visual estimates are preliminary and may differ materially from laboratory assays, and results are still pending. This represents performance ahead of what might have been expected from an early-stage exploration programme, though not a formal guidance upgrade.
metrics_ahead: All three initial drill holes intersected visible spodumene mineralization
Scale of intercepts described as exceeding expectations for maiden drilling programme
Broad mineralized zones consistent with and building on Kennecott's earlier observations

results.headline: Presentation of Interim Results
results.key_quote: Primary endpoint was met. At the Day 182, the two pDNA arms showed the largest mean reductions in DNA-methylation age...None of the differences versus control reached statistical significance...Given the small number of animals per arm, these results are directional and hypothesis-generating.
results.summary: Genflow reports interim results from its SLAB-VET-001 canine study of SIRT6c gene therapy. The primary endpoint was met with pDNA arms showing mean reductions in epigenetic age (−1.08 years low dose, −0.48 years high dose vs −0.07 years control), but differences were not statistically significant (p=0.088). The company characterizes results as 'directional and hypothesis-generating' rather than definitively positive. Safety profile was good with no treatment-related serious adverse events. The study has been extended with a Day 320 read scheduled as the pre-specified primary endpoint. No comparison to market or analyst expectations is stated.
